title: selaginella arbuscula
intro: Selaginella arbuscula, commonly known as Desert Fern or Dwarf Resurrection Fern, is a species of plant in the family Selaginellaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve respiratory issues, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella arbuscula include its ability to modulate the immune system, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may help to alleviate various health conditions.
